settings.q: Do you offer bulk or corporate pricing?
settings.a: Yes. Send us your quantity and budget through our contact page and we'll share options and pricing.
Yes, personalised gift sets are available. Tell us what you'd like printed when you get in touch.

settings.q: Can you deliver to multiple addresses?
settings.a: Yes. Share the address list with us and we'll handle the rest.

settings.q: When should I order for Christmas?
settings.a: For corporate and bulk orders, get in touch three to four weeks ahead so there's time to pack and dispatch. Individual orders are processed within 1–2 business days.

Orders are processed within 1–2 business days (Monday–Friday). UK Standard Delivery takes 3–5 business days and is free on orders over £40 (otherwise £3.99). UK Express Delivery takes 1–2 business days (£6.99). You'll get tracking details by email once your order ships. See shipping & delivery.
